name: Ingestion health
description: Rows per stream and protocol, clock skew and truncation markers.

panels.title: Events by stream
panels.query: service:$service | stats count() by stream span auto

panels.title: Events by protocol
panels.query: service:$service | stats count() by protocol span auto

panels.title: Spans by stream
panels.query: source spans | service:$service | stats count() by stream span auto

panels.title: Metric points by stream
panels.query: source metrics | service:$service | stats count() by stream span auto

panels.title: Clock-skewed events
panels.query: service:$service and _tidemark.clock_skew:true | stats count() by service, protocol

panels.title: Truncated events
panels.query: service:$service and _tidemark.truncated:true | stats count() by service, protocol

options.content: Paused streams and dropped rows are listed under Settings → System.
